name: Hotel Almhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Almhof welcomes guests to a sunny, peaceful setting on Mühlenweg in Neustift im Stubaital, framed by the majestic peaks of the Stubai Alps. This family-managed four-star hotel features stylish rooms and suites decorated in an elegant alpine country aesthetic, equipped with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting panoramic views towards the snow-covered three-thousand-metre summits. The extensive on-site spa facility, boasting diverse saunas, steam rooms, a whirlpool, and tranquil relaxation lounges, guarantees deeply soothing recovery after mountain adventures. In the dining room, guests are treated to refined Tyrolean culinary classics. The Elferbahnen lifts and Neustift's village centre are close at hand, while complimentary ski buses provide swift access to the Stubai Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star hotel on Mühlenweg in Neustift im Stubaital featuring an exclusive spa, panoramic dining, and close to the Stubai Glacier.
